body.x: DoItPlanet Inc. (CEO Byeong-Ki Yoo) announced its participation in CES 2025 in Las Vegas, USA, from January 7 to 10 at the K-Startup Pavilion.

DoItPlanet has been recognized for its services supporting corporate clients’ digital transformation. The company digitizes key business assets like documents to establish paperless workflows, enhancing office efficiency and earning high customer satisfaction.

DoItPlanet’s flagship service is DoIt D-Biz, a document digitization and collection platform. At CES 2025, the company will unveil flocs.AI, a centralized document management and AI chatbot solution designed to streamline data collection and utilization within organizations.

flocs.AI is built to collect and analyze various types of data across organizations. It supports the digital conversion of electronic and paper-based documents and integrates seamlessly with standard formats like PDF and MS Word, ensuring flexibility in data use.

Collected corporate data is centrally managed within a cloud environment, with robust organizational security protocols enabling systematic classification of user access rights. flocs.AI simplifies data preparation for AI training, maximizing the value and usability of document assets.

body.cap: flocs.AI dashboard interface | Image provided by DoItPlanet

body.x: The integrated AI chatbot enhances the solution by delivering reliable responses based on corporate document information, enabling accurate and swift decision-making. It also optimizes information utilization with a conversational interface that allows users to search for needed data quickly and easily. Additionally, the chatbot can recommend supporting documents, streamlining complex data environments.

Flocs.AI is positioned as a next-generation solution that combines advanced data management and AI technologies to improve organizational efficiency and support smart, data-driven decision-making. It is expected to receive strong interest from both domestic and international clients.

A DoItPlanet representative stated, “Through CES 2025, we aim to introduce flocs.AI, which revolutionizes data management and work efficiency for businesses. We plan to enhance our brand image by showcasing our expertise in advanced technology applications and communicating our vision to global markets and potential partners.”

The representative added, “Building on the adoption of DoIt D-Biz by over 90 public institutions and large and medium-sized companies, we will expand our client base while leveraging flocs.AI to strengthen long-term partnerships and attract new clients. Furthermore, we aim to refine flocs.AI’s technology to meet international standards, making it a solution that satisfies global market demands.”

body.x: AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
